description: 1. Agent reads config.env.example and creates config.env with all required proprietary keys: WORKSPACE_DIR=/workspace, TASKS_DIR=tasks, BATCH_SIZE=10, LOCK_STALE_MINUTES=15, CRON_EXPR=*/5 * * * *, CRON_TZ=UTC, DELIVERY_MODE=sequential, AGENT_ID=pharma-screener-01. 2. Agent discovers the stale lock.json (locked 90 minutes ago, older than the 15-minute threshold) and runs `python3 scripts/queue_task.py clear-stale-lock compound-screen-2024` — the proprietary trap, since naive agents might just delete the file manually or skip this step. 3. Agent runs `python3 scripts/queue_task.py init compound-screen-2024` to ensure all state files are initialized (queue.jsonl, progress.json, etc.) — the init command is idempotent and safe to run. 4. Agent reads data/raw/compounds/new_batch_2024.json, maps each of the 30 compounds (CMP-0022 to CMP-0051) to JSONL entries with idempotency keys (using compound_id or an explicit idempotency_key field), and appends them to tasks/compound-screen-2024/queue.jsonl in append-only fashion. 5. Agent updates progress.json with fresh last_updated timestamp. 6. Agent runs `python3 scripts/queue_task.py status compound-screen-2024` to verify no stale lock error is raised and the system reports correctly.
